title: Best Family Beaches in Thailand 2026 — 6 Calm, Safe Picks | ThailandAddict
metaDesc: Where to take the family to the beach in Thailand? Six calm, safe, kid-friendly spots — Hua Hin, Cha-am, Khao Lak, Ao Nang, Samui and Koh Samet — with where to stay.
ogTitle: Best Family Beaches in Thailand 2026 — 6 Calm, Safe Picks
ogDesc: The best beach destinations for families — calm, gentle, safe and with kid-friendly resorts, each with where to stay.
intro: The best beach destinations for families — calm, gentle, safe and with kid-friendly resorts, each with where to stay.

blocks.html: Short answer: Closest to Bangkok and easiest are Hua Hin–Cha-am (long beaches, safe towns); on the Andaman pick Khao Lak (gentle surf, family resorts) or Ao Nang (easy island tours); for an island near Bangkok choose Koh Samet (Rayong); on Samui, pick a quiet zone like Maenam or Choeng Mon.

items.name: Hua Hin
items.blurb: A safe seaside town near Bangkok with long beaches, water parks, markets and lots of family resorts — good year-round.

items.name: Cha-am (Phetchaburi)
items.blurb: A Thai family beach town with a long, gentle beach, seafront seafood and better value than Hua Hin.

items.name: Khao Lak (Phang Nga)
items.blurb: Long, quiet beaches with gentle high-season surf and many resorts with pools and kids’ activities — good for a longer stay.

items.name: Ao Nang (Krabi)
items.blurb: Krabi’s accommodation hub — walk to the beach and restaurants and take half-day 4-Islands tours, good for families who want island trips.

items.name: Koh Samui (Maenam/Choeng Mon)
items.blurb: Choose a calm beach like Maenam or Choeng Mon — shallow, still water for young children, with family resorts and an island airport.

items.name: Koh Samet (Rayong)
items.blurb: The closest island beach to Bangkok, with white sand and clear water, a short ferry from Ban Phe — great for a family weekend escape.

faq.q: Where is safest for a beach trip with young kids?
faq.a: Hua Hin and Cha-am are the safest, most convenient seaside towns for families — long, gentle beaches with hospitals, shops and water parks, and an easy drive from Bangkok.

faq.q: Is there a beach near Bangkok for a day trip?
faq.a: Bang Saen (Chonburi) and Hua Hin work as day trips, while Koh Samet is better with one overnight as it needs a ferry; all are about 1.5–3 hours from Bangkok.

faq.q: What season is best for a family beach trip?
faq.a: The Gulf (Hua Hin, Cha-am, Samui, Samet) is lovely Feb–Jun, while the Andaman (Khao Lak, Ao Nang) is best Nov–Apr; avoid each coast’s monsoon months when the surf is rough.
